name: craft_photos
description: Develop an existing raster photo using optional self-hosted LightCraft: adjust exposure and export full-size PNG. Sources are required. First adapter accepts PNG/JPEG/WebP; RAW and batch library operations are not exposed.

sources.description: Source stash:// references, permitted local paths, or craft://project/artifact references from previous output. Native projects cannot be uploaded.

project_id.description: Existing gateway project for follow-up edits and Craft artifact reuse. Omit for a new project.

availability.setup_hint: Run jarvis-craft-tools/setup.sh on the app host, then set CRAFT_API_URL and CRAFT_API_KEY in the selected mode ENV. See jarvis-craft-tools/README.md.
